exact_revisions: No revision hash is written in this file. The detect-secrets hook reads any bare hex string, including a 12-char abbreviation, as a secret, and clearing it means adding an entry to .secrets.baseline -- which the permission layer refused. That refusal is reported, not worked around, and the hashes were not reformatted to slip past the scanner either. Abbreviated revisions are in docs/tts-licences.md; the exact 40-char values are in app/tts_runtime/pins/indic_parler.json and pins/indicf5.json, which were already allowlisted. Recompute any of them with HfApi().model_info(repo).sha.
pins_were_already_correct: The revisions the authenticated API returns are byte-for-byte the ones this repo pinned WITHOUT a token, via the public tree API: both indic_parler and indicf5 match app/tts_runtime/pins/*.json exactly. The token-less pinning method is now confirmed against the authenticated source. indic_conformer has no pins file yet.
